nodes.title: Ideogram 4.5 Edit (PAID API - run only after approval)

widgets_values:
CHARACTER SPECS (edit only these five values):
NAME: 
AGE: 35
HEIGHT: 180cm
WEIGHT: 65kg
GENDER: male

Create a photographic character turnaround reference sheet of the person in @Image1, built to the CHARACTER SPECS above.

IDENTITY from @Image1 only: face, facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, glasses, earrings, outfit, colours and shoes. Do NOT copy the head size or body proportions from @Image1; it is a close-up portrait and its framing makes the head look large.

BODY PROPORTIONS from the SPECS: a realistic adult with the given HEIGHT and WEIGHT (for example, 180cm and 65kg means a tall, slim, long-legged build). The figure is 8 heads tall: head height is one eighth of total height, the crotch sits exactly at half of total height, legs are half the body, fingertips reach mid-thigh, shoulders are about two head-widths wide, narrow waist, slim arms and legs. Natural adult anatomy, no oversized head, no short legs, no chibi or caricature proportions.

LAYOUT: one wide landscape sheet with a dark brown rounded outer border on a warm greige background. Inside, a light grey sheet divided by thin vertical lines into five tall, equal-width panels, left to right, with small thin all-caps sans-serif headers: "FACE CLOSE UP", "FRONT", "BACK", "LEFT PROFILE", "RIGHT PROFILE".
Panel 1 FACE CLOSE UP: head-and-shoulders photo facing the camera, neutral expression, in a framed box in the upper part. Below it, five left-aligned form lines filled with the SPECS exactly as written: "NAME:", "AGE:", "HEIGHT:", "WEIGHT:", "GENDER:".
Panels 2 to 5: the full body, head to feet, standing straight with arms relaxed at the sides. The figure fills about 90 percent of the panel height. All four figures share the same scale, the same feet baseline and the same top-of-head line. Panel 2 FRONT faces the camera. Panel 3 BACK is seen from directly behind. Panel 4 LEFT PROFILE is a 90 degree side view facing left. Panel 5 RIGHT PROFILE is a 90 degree side view facing right.
Each of panels 2 to 5 has a thin vertical height ruler along its right edge, from 0 at the feet baseline to the HEIGHT value at the top of the head, labelled with the HEIGHT value at the top, with evenly spaced tick marks.

Even soft studio lighting, plain light grey panel backgrounds, clean full-length catalogue photography. No other text, logos or watermarks.
nodes.title: Character sheet prompt (layout described in text)

widgets_values:
## W5_07 Character sheet

- Only input: **one person photo** (image_1). Full body, front-facing, plain background works best.
- The sheet layout (5 panels, headers, form lines, rulers) comes from the prompt; no layout image is used.
- Output size: 2560x1440 (16:9).
- Students change only the photo and the five CHARACTER SPECS values at the top of the prompt.
- Body proportions come from HEIGHT/WEIGHT (8-heads-tall rule), not from the photo: a close-up portrait makes the head look large.

Limits: BACK and PROFILE views are invented by the model from one photo. Panel count, header text and ruler marks can come out wrong. Check every panel.

Paid API node: one run per approval.
